en.headline: 3 commits, 2 issues, 1 discussion reply across two repos
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, sogeisetsu made **3 own commits** plus 4 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` across two repositories. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 2 own commits updated the daily report attribution logic to support aliases and documented the alias mapping in the agents docs. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, 1 own commit tagged the `v1.15.5` release. On the issues side, 2 items were opened or closed in `openchamber/openchamber`: issue `#4920` was opened reporting that the context panel breakdown bar divides whole-session estimates by the last message's input so `其他` is always 0%, and issue `#4346` was closed noting that `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passes after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`. The user also joined an existing discussion in `openchamber/openchamber`, replying in discussion `#4821` titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel". No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded, and no section hit its collection cap.

zh.headline: 3 次提交、2 个 issue、1 条讨论回复，涉及两个仓库
zh.summary: 2026-10-15，sogeisetsu 在两个仓库中完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 4 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，2 次本人提交为日报归属逻辑增加别名支持，并在 agents 文档中补充了别名映射说明。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，1 次本人提交打上了 `v1.15.5` 发布标签。issue 方面，在 `openchamber/openchamber` 中新开或关闭了 2 个：新开了 `#4920`，指出上下文面板的 breakdown bar 用最后一条消息的输入量去除整场估算值，导致 `其他` 始终为 0%；关闭了 `#4346`，说明 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 在 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后仍然通过。用户还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的既有讨论 `#4821`（标题为 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel"）中参与回复。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release，且没有任何分节触及采集上限。
